title: A Semester for the Homecoming
author: Ansel Crane
blurb: Odile Almeida, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
